item.title: 📆 Top News Today Keeping the pace: the Russian troops took control over Malaya Volchya
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🚩 Keeping the pace: the Russian troops took control over Malaya Volchya in Kharkov region and liberated Rozovka in Zaporozhye region. 💥 Rushin' in and maxed out : the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation hit enterprises of the metallurgical and electronic industries, the defence industry of Ukraine, energy and transport infrastructures in Kiev, Zaporozhye, and Odessa regions as well vessels supporting the Armed Forces of Ukraine. ✈️ Smashing the enemy: the Russian aerospace forces delivered air strikes by FAB-500 aerial bombs against temporary deployment areas of the AFU . ▫️ Enemy falls back under our pressure : the CO of an anti-aircraft missile battery from the Yuzhnaya Group's 1465th Motorised Rifle Regiment with the call sign 'Pamir' told about operations of units in settlements of Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. ⚓️ Pacific-style calibration: the submarine Ufa of the Pacific Fleet fires Kalibr missiles at naval and coastal targets during drills. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Throughout the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes
item.description: ❗️ Throughout the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against Ukrainian ports as well as vessels used in support of the AFU. 🔥 As a result of the strikes, a dry cargo ship carrying military cargo was hit in the port of Chernomorsk, Odessa region. 💥 Moreover, a dry cargo ship carrying military equipment to the port of Izmail to support the Ukrainian Armed Forces was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚫 What a twist Drones of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces neutralised an ATV with AFU personnel
item.description: 🚫 What a twist Drones of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces neutralised an ATV with AFU personnel close to Slavyansk. The driver spotted a Russian drone, lost control, and tumbled into a ditch along with the ATV and the passenger. The rotation is disrupted. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Enemy falls back under our pressure The CO of an anti-aircraft missile battery from the Yuzhnaya Group's 1465th Motorised Rifle Regiment with the call sign 'Pamir'
item.description: ▫️ Enemy falls back under our pressure 💬 The CO of an anti-aircraft missile battery from the Yuzhnaya Group's 1465th Motorised Rifle Regiment with the call sign 'Pamir' told about operations of units in settlements of Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. 'Our drones fly in Druzhkovka, Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka. Now, there are less R18 drones over Konstantinovka. It means our AD units progress, operate. We're moving forward. Their UAV command posts pull back. The range no longer allows them to deploy drones and deliver any kind of logistics.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29464

▫️
Enemy falls back under our pressure
💬
The CO of an anti-aircraft missile battery from the Yuzhnaya Group's 1465th Motorised Rifle Regiment with the call sign 'Pamir'
told about operations of units in settlements of Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration.
'Our drones fly in Druzhkovka, Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka. Now, there are less R18 drones over Konstantinovka. It means our AD units progress, operate. We're moving forward. Their UAV command posts pull back. The range no longer allows them to deploy drones and deliver any kind of logistics.'
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💥 Kicking adversary day and night The Russian aviation delivered air strikes by FAB-500 aerial bombs against temporary deployment areas of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
